identity: event_id binds pool, reference, exact A/B/C workers, core, n and actual m; team_key identifies pool and actual member set

arms.B: same-class replacement block plus identical core
arms.C: other-class replacement block plus identical core

aggregation: event means within pool, equal pools within building, equal buildings; denominators are not unique independent teams
failures: quality and continuous unavailable values stay missing; joint stability requires complete geometry and retains incomplete attempts as false
main: both complete, absolute B8L2 difference <=2, floor Jaccard difference <=0.05, same node count and bound cyclic distance <=3 degrees
strict: 1 / 0.02 / 2 degrees; same complete and node-count conditions
wide: 5 / 0.10 / 5 degrees; same complete and node-count conditions
net_Q: C_B8L2 minus B_B8L2; signed effect, separate from A/B versus A/C interchangeability
geometry: preserve original frozen ring and points, mean-height prism IoU is a proxy rather than ideal 3D solid IoU
subset_support: high_Q_threshold uses original history-only threshold label; supported flags retain prior domain opportunities and missingness; no new types fitted
evaluation_boundary: original discovery/validation phase labels describe previous split, all images already explored; additional cores are registered before computation but not external validation
human_review: 2026-10-20 case-level feedback is summarized in README.md and CORNER_REVIEW.md; no numeric threshold change or population-rate interpretation
scoring: B8L2 main, D10 sensitivity, N1 unchanged
criterion_components: geometry_main removes Q limit from main; quality_main retains completeness and Q difference only; descriptive decomposition, not new adopted threshold

corner_review.case_key: case 1..4 in REVIEW_CASES.json; image and pair AB/AC/BC; corner_A_index zero-based after binding B,C to A
corner_review.units: wrapped pixels on 1024x512; BEV and top Euclidean distances in camera-height h; signed deltas are second team minus first
corner_review.normalization: bev_percent_radius uses first-team corner radial distance; bev_percent_diagonal uses first-team floor bounding-box diagonal
corner_review.interpretation: same-structure case diagnostics only; not a new adopted classification threshold or global success rate

panel_corner_extension.matching: floor signed-area winding normalization for diagnostic indexing only, then frozen cyclic angular match; record legacy angle and reversal; equal count and unique match do not alone prove semantic equality
panel_corner_extension.metrics: BEV and top 3D mean/max h; max/A floor bounding diagonal percent; no coordinate fitting
panel_corner_extension.aggregation: identical events for within/cross; equal events within pool, pools within building, buildings overall; event median and p90 explicitly separate
panel_corner_extension.cross_larger: cross distance exceeds within distance by 1e-9 h or percent numerical tolerance; direction fraction only, not similarity success rate
panel_corner_extension.sensitivity: joint angle <=9 or <=12 only neighborhood sensitivity, no new human acceptance thresholds
panel_corner_extension.preservation: retain all451 events including58 non-common events; old Q, old geometry distances and original success flags unchanged

structure_extension.pairing: A/B within composition, A/C cross composition; same background, n, m, source counts and reference
structure_extension.count_changed: node counts differ; not necessarily loss or deterioration
structure_extension.reference_sets: stored Hungarian angular endpoint matching at 5/9 degrees; symmetric difference divided by reference node count; lost/gained are counts
structure_extension.missingness: unknown diagnostics remain null; quality unavailability and completeness separate; paired availability per metric, no zero imputation
structure_extension.aggregation: equal events within pool, equal pools within building, equal buildings; raw event sums separately labeled
structure_extension.vote_margin: min selected A support minus minimum_support; vulnerable when margin < m; ignores new nodes and regrouping, exploratory not a certificate
structure_extension.cases: S1-S3 post-hoc illustrations; S1/S2 same image, no extra independent support

vote_trace.scope: 58 noncommon events / 174 teams; outcome-selected mechanism sample, not population rate
vote_trace.identity: public worker_id + source_pair_index; retained observation universe identical; feature_id only local to team
vote_trace.relation: bipartite connected components through exact shared observations; one-to-one, split, merge, many-to-many or unlinked; no geometric forced match
vote_trace.votes: support per group; support_delta = incoming_votes - outgoing_votes + retained_delta; summed support of complex components is not a single-node vote
vote_trace.selected: all selected and unselected groups retained; compare selected counts per component separately from score
vote_trace.replay: frozen fuse, all final candidate geometries identical, scoring not rerun
